subject: Remediation status and artifacts for auth, logging, and permissions findings
messages:
From: Raj Patel <raj@acme-corp.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: red-team@pentestco.io
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pen-test artifacts & remediation ETAs for recent findings

Hi Aisha / Lauren,

Thanks again for taking the time during the review call yesterday. PentestCo flagged a few items in the categories below and our compliance team needs a short remediation status and evidence bundle to close the SOC-related gaps on our side:

- Auth: token replay and session fixation recommendation (finding PT-17)
- Logging: missing session start/stop events in frontends (PT-21)
- Permissions: overly permissive service account in data ingestion pipeline (PT-04)
- Secrets: keystore not rotated per policy (PT-09)

Could you share:
1) Current state (in-progress / fixed / scheduled) for each of the items above
2) ETA for final proof-of-fix where applicable
3) Any artifacts you can share now (screenshots, logs redacted, keystore rotation proof, diff of patch)

We'd like a short one-page summary we can attach to our SIG/SOC packet and any Drive links to the evidence. If you prefer a quick sync to walk through the artifacts, we can do that tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks,
Raj
Security Program Manager
Acme Logistics

--
Attachment: acme_pt_summary_request.txt (1 KB stub)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj@acme-corp.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pen-test artifacts & remediation ETAs for recent findings

Hi Raj — thanks for the clear ask. Below is the current status and next steps; I included the owners and short ETAs so your compliance team can see the timeline.

Summary status (short):
- Auth (PT-17): Fix deployed to canary yesterday; rollout to prod scheduled tonight. ETA for full prod rollout and verification: 2027-06-16 23:59 PDT. Artifact: auth_fix_patch.diff (attached) and session-replay test logs (will provide).
- Logging (PT-21): Logging config updated to emit session start/stop; change landed in config repo but we need to retain 7 days of indexed events for evidence. ETA for evidence capture and redaction: 2027-06-17 12:00 PDT. Artifact: logging-config-screenshot.png (attached).
- Permissions (PT-04): Service account scoped to least privilege in two commits; pending automated integration tests to confirm no regressions. ETA: 2027-06-18 18:00 PDT. Test run IDs: SEC-712 (see related_links).
- Secrets (PT-09): Keystore rotation completed for the ingestion cluster; rotation proof file: keystore_rotation_proof.txt (attached). Rotation occurred 2027-06-15 03:10 UTC.

We uploaded a provisional one-page bundle to a Drive folder and will add the final artifacts as they are produced: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AcmEvEvidenceFolder

If that level of detail works, I'll push the final artifacts by end-of-day Thursday and can join a 30-min walkthrough if you want.

Thanks — Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: auth_fix_patch.diff (text patch), logging-config-screenshot.png (PNG), keystore_rotation_proof.txt (text)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:20:43 -0700
Subject: Internal: artifact handoff & verification owners for ACME PT items

Team — tagging owners and deliverables; ACME wants evidence for their SOC packet. Keep replies internal until we've redacted logs and uploaded proofs.

Owners / asks:
- Dev (dev_patel): confirm prod rollout for auth fix completed and paste replay test logs (redacted). Deadline: 2027-06-16 23:59 PDT.
- Lauren (lauren_bishop): capture 7 days of session start/stop events, create redacted sampling JSON, and drop a short README describing filters used. Deadline: 2027-06-17 12:00 PDT.
- Ben (ben_carter): run the integration tests over the least-privilege SA change and attach the test report (SEC-712). Deadline: 2027-06-18 18:00 PDT.

Also: make sure each artifact includes a one-line explanation for the Acme compliance reviewer (e.g., "auth_fix_patch.diff: mitigation for PT-17 — changes to token validation and cookie settings").

I'll assemble the final one-page bundle and upload to the Drive folder.

Thanks — Aisha

--
Internal note: avoid including raw access tokens or PII in artifacts; redaction checklist in the SEC SOP applies.

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj@acme-corp.com>, red-team@pentestco.io
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Final evidence bundle and closure ETA for ACME PT items

Hi Raj / PentestCo — short update and link to the artifacts you requested. Thank you for your patience.

Status (final):
- Auth (PT-17): Deployed to prod 2027-06-16 22:45 PDT. Attached: auth_fix_patch.diff, session_replay_tests_redacted.log (uploaded to Drive). Verification note: automated replay suite passed (run id SEC-712-R1).
- Logging (PT-21): Session start/stop events now emitted and indexed. We captured 7 days of events and redacted user identifiers. Artifact: logging-config-screenshot.png and session_events_sample.json (redacted) in Drive. Evidence capture window: 2027-06-10 -> 2027-06-17.
- Permissions (PT-04): SA trimmed to least-privilege, integration test report attached (integration_report_SEC-712.pdf). No functional regressions detected in smoke tests.
- Secrets (PT-09): Keystore rotated on 2027-06-15 03:10 UTC. Proof: keystore_rotation_proof.txt (contains rotation timestamps and KMS reference IDs).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AcmEvEvidenceFolder (artifacts labeled with the PT IDs and short readme files).

Please confirm receipt and tell us if you need additional redactions or expanded logs. If everything looks good on your end, we can mark these items as mitigated in the joint tracker and close the related SIG/SOC checklist items.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: acme_pt_summary.pdf (short bundle), auth_fix_patch.diff, keystore_rotation_proof.txt, logging-config-screenshot.png
